output:

    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
params:
  release_dir: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE)
dir <- params$release_dir
read_tbl <- function(name) {
  path <- file.path(dir,paste0(name,".csv"))
  if (file.exists(path)) utils::read.csv(path,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  else data.frame()
}
overview <- read_tbl("dataset_overview")
sites <- read_tbl("site_summary")
dates <- read_tbl("date_summary")
categories <- read_tbl("category_summary")
qc <- read_tbl("validation_summary")
manifest <- read_tbl("manifest")
```

This report summarizes aggregate statistics from *explicitly pinned, checksum-verified* local RDA files. It contains **no clinical note text or patient-level records**. Maternal records are not multiplied across pregnancies. The laboratory extracts are excluded while warehouse identifiers are being corrected.

## Release and quality checks

```{r qc}
if (nrow(qc)) {
  cat("QC checks passed:",sum(qc$passed),"/",nrow(qc),"\n\n")
  knitr::kable(qc)
} else cat("QC report missing.")
```

## Data provenance

Input paths and checksums below identify the source artifacts used for this report. This page is an operational release report; it does not establish encounter-specific maternal event assignment or prove clinical note text retrieval.

```{r manifest}
if (nrow(manifest)) knitr::kable(manifest) else cat("Manifest unavailable.")
```

## Remaining dependencies

- Maternal inpatient and outpatient medication rebuild scripts must be present and verified before claiming full raw-to-release reproducibility.
- Clinical-notes metadata must be independently crosswalked to actual clinical-note text.
- Laboratory inputs remain excluded until the warehouse corrects the ID namespace.
